title: Idempotence of the two actual Cech completion unit maps
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, r a natural number (possibly zero), and b a Fin r-indexed list of global sections of O. Assume the unbounded derived category of O-module sheaves. Put L=RHom(C_b,-) with the actual augmented Cech complex and unit eta of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For every derived object E, both L.map(eta_E) and eta_(L E) are isomorphisms. These assertions concern the specified maps rather than an unspecified isomorphism L(L(E)) ≅ L(E).

proof.text: 1. The ring complex and each two-term localization factor are K-flat by bounded-above flatness. Localization sheaves are flat by the proved sectionwise localization and sheafification argument in RingedLocalizationModels. Induct on the length of the ordered tensor, using the tensor associator to prove K-flatness of the extended Cech complex.

2. Apply the tensor-augmentation-cone acyclicity lemma. The tensor/mapping-cone isomorphism makes id_K tensor epsilon a quasi-isomorphism. Naturality of the braiding and cancellation of its quasi-isomorphism give epsilon tensor id_K.

3. For any augmented K-flat complex with these two quasi-isomorphisms, apply naturality of KFlatRHom.curryIso to the morphisms (id,(epsilon.op,id)) and (epsilon.op,(id,id)) in the product of K-flat full subcategories and the derived category. On the tensor side the maps are invertible because Q inverts both quasi-isomorphisms. Cancellation of the components of curryIso makes the corresponding iterated RHom precomposition maps invertible. The specified ringedDerivedHomUnit is invertible: its factors are the ring-Hom evaluation isomorphism, the K-injective replacement quasi-isomorphism under Q, the localization-factorization isomorphism, and the representative isomorphism. The specified completion unit is this isomorphism followed by augmentation precomposition. Functoriality and composition of isomorphisms prove both assertions.

proof_origin.note: K3: tensor-cone acyclicity is isolated as the sole new hole. K-flatness, the two tensor projections, and naturality/cancellation for both actual unit maps are implemented in Lean; no separate unit-currying coherence assertion is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem ringed_cech_completion_unit_idempotence (E : ringedSiteDerived O) :
    IsIso ((ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1).map
      (ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
        (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 E)) ∧
    IsIso (ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
      (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2
      ((ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1).obj E))
